title: add NVTX ranges and microbench instrumentation for runtime kernels, KV-cache and continuous batching
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds NVTX ranges and a small microbenchmark harness for runtime kernels, KV cache hits/misses, and continuous batching. Exposes counters and tags consumed by new Grafana dashboards. No public API changes.
description: Motivation: We've had trouble correlating tail-latency regressions to specific kernel paths and KV-cache behavior during heavy continuous-batching workloads. This PR introduces NVTX ranges in the runtime critical path (attention kernels, matmul paths, kv-cache lookup/insert), lightweight counters for KV cache hit/miss/evict, and a microbench harness to reproduce common sequence-length and batch-size distributions. Changes: 1) NVTX scopes around kernel dispatch, attention forward/backward stubs, KV cache lookup/insert, batching/coalescing boundaries; 2) A microbench tool (tools/microbench) that runs configurable workload shapes and emits per-range timings and counts; 3) Small runtime APIs to expose counters via /metrics endpoint and to tag spans for tracing; 4) Example Grafana dashboards and a script to ingest microbench output into our performance dashboards. Testing: added unit tests for counter correctness and integration microbench runs to CI (short smoke). Benchmarks: we include local microbench outputs showing 5-8% variance reduction in batch coalescing overhead and ability to attribute 60% of tail latency to KV cache eviction churn on a pathological trace. Rollout: feature gated behind telemetry.enable_nvtx and telemetry.microbench flags; default off in prod. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes. See linked Linear tickets for background and perf runs.

performance_summary: Local microbench (seq_len distribution: [16:50%, 128:30%, 512:20%], batch sizes 1-32) shows NVTX markers correctly separating dispatch, kernel, and kv-cache time. Observed scenario: when eviction rate > 5% tail p99 reduced by ~12% after kv-cache tuning; continuous batching overhead attribution clarified (kernel dispatch vs coalescing).
merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Lina Gómez on 2026-02-18 after approvals. Merge commit message: 'telemetry: add NVTX scopes + microbench harness for runtime attribution (ENG-6428)'.
notes_for_ops: Telemetry gated off by default in prod. To enable for troubleshooting, set telemetry.enable_nvtx=true and telemetry.microbench.enabled=true via config. Microbench artifacts are uploaded to the perf bucket when run with --upload. Dashboards added under Observability > Performance > Microbench.
